about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Ofgem raised Jan-Mar 2027 cap 26% to £2,166 (+£443) due to Middle East gas prices; £100 payment in Jan; Cornwall Insight sees April dipping 1% to £2,151.
389-page Fairfield review (25 Nov) finds Met still institutionally racist, misogynistic and homophobic with good progress on 0 of 14 Casey recommendations.
Board reinstated Huang as CEO on 23 Nov citing US government input; Kress back to CFO; internal probe, SEC, FBI, DoJ, California AG and House inquiries continue.

Irish EU presidency proposed 'Made in Europe' car assembly partner status for UK without Chinese EV tariff alignment; EU ministers consider text on 3 Dec; European Partnerships Bill due before Christmas.
IRGC said two more tankers hit mines on 25 Nov after four on 24 Nov; Vance and Rubio met Qatari PM on 23 Nov; Trump says US is funded until end of January.
Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia (24-25 Nov) killed 2 and injured up to 50; Zelensky continues push for four-way talks before Christmas.
Likud and Yashar ended a second round without a deal on 22 Nov; Eisenkot's bloc has 48 seats; deadline 6 Dec plus possible 14 days.

threads.topic: Anthropic post-IPO and AI safety pacing
threads.status: ANT fell below $83 IPO price to $81.91 on 24 Nov; Axios reports OpenAI/Anthropic staff safety clash alongside Pachocki's 0.68-0.70 log-perplexity ceiling proposal.
Drupal RCE CVE-2026-132165 found by Anthropic OSS Scanner added to CISA KEV 24 Nov; GreyNoise GT13 Check Point campaign and CIA/ODNI OSINT breach suspected of using AI offensive tools.
Qatar GP 27-29 Nov (race Sun 16:00 UK) carries FIA-Pirelli 27-lap max tyre stint cap forcing 2+ stops; Cadillac reportedly kept Bottas with Perez for 2027.
McLaren enters Qatar GP seeking first Lusail win after 4 podiums by Norris and Piastri in 3 years and Las Vegas double podium.
PrismML shipped 5.9 GB Apache 2.0 Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B on 24 Nov; Z.ai GLM-5.4 (750B looped) out to subscribers on 23 Nov with weights pending.
Lean artifact of about 17 million lines community-certified 21 Nov with checks outstanding; mathematical explanation pending.
Extended notice of intention to appoint administrators expires midnight 25 Nov; Zachert Private Equity, Xyra and Martin Property among suitors for ~11,000 jobs.
25-26 Nov strike in England paused on 11 Nov for formal pay and conditions talks; BMA warns of further action if talks stall.
